newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis higher, SRW wheat down.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy basis higher, SRW wheat down.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were mostly one cent per bushel higher, while soft red winter wheat basis values slipped three cents from Tuesday, export sources said. Corn basis values were mostly steady.
Dealers said light farmer selling of corn and soybeans supported those basis values.
Soft red winter wheat values were pressured by a lack of export demand. Hard red winter wheat values were steady.
Results were awaited on India's tender for 50,000 tonnes or more of optional-origin wheat. Sri Lanka should tender Feb 6 for 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin wheat.
